{735金叉及趋势}
{来源=human; 类型=trend_following; 显式配对735金叉及趋势.tn6}
{风格=balanced; 约3%止损、约8%止盈由回测参数 stop_loss/take_profit 落地，非公式内置}
MA7:=MA(C,7);
MA35:=MA(C,35);
DEV:=(MA7-MA35)/MA35*100;
UP7:=MA7>REF(MA7,1);
UP35:=MA35>REF(MA35,1);
TJ1:=CROSS(MA7,MA35) AND UP7 AND UP35;
TJ2:=MA7>MA35 AND UP7 AND UP35 AND DEV<=2;
XG:TJ1 OR TJ2;
